output_list.criticism: The approveAndCall() function does not require the spender to be the one who is allowed to spend the funds from a user. The approveAndCall() function can be called by a spender, but only by user, which means spender is able to transfer approved funds from any users' balance, instead of just the user who made the approveAndCall() call. This could lead to token devalue if spender does not implement receiveApproval(), or if the spender does not make the correct checks. The approveAndCall() function can be removed to prevent this vulnerability.
